name: extract_entities
description: Extract structured entities from user message for RFQ creation workflow based on actual GMT/RFQ API fields

projectDesc.description: Project description for the RFQ (REQUIRED by GMT API)

description.description: Item description as required by RFQ API (REQUIRED)

quantity.description: Required quantity - numeric value (REQUIRED for RFQ)

unitofMeasures.description: Unit of measurement: pcs, kg, meters, etc. (REQUIRED for RFQ API)

deliveryDate.description: Required delivery date in ISO format (REQUIRED for RFQ creation)

division.description: Division from GMT API list: Admin & IT, CAPEX - Equipment & Machinery, Civil & Electrical Works, etc. (REQUIRED)

category.description: Product category: Agriculture Equipments, Air Logistics, Automotive, etc. (OPTIONAL - can be null initially)

brand.description: Preferred brand name (OPTIONAL - can be 'Any' or specific)

state.description: Delivery state location (OPTIONAL - part of delivery location)

city.description: Delivery city location (OPTIONAL - part of delivery location)

pincode.description: Delivery pincode (OPTIONAL - part of delivery location)

serialNo.description: Serial number for RFQ item (OPTIONAL - can be auto-generated)

completeness.description: Percentage of required RFQ API fields (projectDesc, description, quantity, unitofMeasures, deliveryDate, division) that have values

missing_required_fields.description: List of required GMT/RFQ API fields that are missing: projectDesc, description, quantity, unitofMeasures, deliveryDate, division

missing_optional_fields.description: List of optional RFQ API fields that could be helpful: category, brand, state, city, pincode, remarks

confidence.description: Confidence in the entity extraction accuracy

next_questions.description: Suggested questions to ask user for missing required information
